system.description: Beginning at 20th level, when allied creatures benefit from your Projected Barrier or Rallying Barrier class features, they become Shielded until the end of your next turn. While Shielded they can use one ability granted by your Projected Barrier class feature without spending a superiority die, after which they lose the Shielded effect.

source.custom: Imported full source rules; contextual benefits require adjudication.
